notes.title: Wild Willy West - v1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello again Willy lovers!

We're hard at work here at Team Sloop, both making new experiences for you to play, as well as patching Wild Willy!

Here's another small hotfix addressing some issues players were having...

- Added some additional lighting to the cave level, especially around the bridge.
- Added some additional tips to the death screen.
- Fixed a bug causing tips to not appear during the ninja level.
- Added some more dialogue to help clarify what to do during the ninja fight.

Thanks for those who bought the game and supported us on our first project, hope to see you getting wild!

notes.title: Wild Willy West - v1.0.3
notes.content:
Hi Willy lovers!

Here's a small hotfix to the game, allowing you to get wild with 5% less bugs :)

- Added a secret cheat code, revealed by completing the game
- Fixed a bug that changed the camera zoom during the final fight
- Fixed a bug that caused lighting to change during the final fight
- Fixed an issue that was causing some save files to reset upon loading the game (sorry!)

We hope to see you getting wild real soon! 

- Team Sloop
